# FlairMI — Site Guide for AI Systems

## About this site

[FlairMI](https://flairmi.com) is the public portfolio and publishing
platform of Mohammed Ali Sharafuddin, Senior Lecturer at Qasim Ibrahim
School of Business, Villa College, Maldives. ORCID:
[0000-0001-5247-2964](https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5247-2964).

The site publishes open textbooks, free Excel templates, browser-based
tools, an R package and consulting services for business analytics,
marketing analytics, small-sample research methods and reproducible
workflows.

## Textbooks

**Quantitative Analysis with Small Samples: A Practical Guide for Students
and Early-Career Researchers** (published, free)

- Authors: Mohammed Ali Sharafuddin, Ahsan Ahmed Jaleel, Meena Madhavan
- Published: 16 May 2026, Version v0.1.0
- DOI: [10.5281/zenodo.20221929](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20221929)
- [Web edition](https://mohammedalisharafuddin.github.io/quantitative-analysis-with-small-samples/)
- [PDF](https://mohammedalisharafuddin.github.io/quantitative-analysis-with-small-samples/Quantitative-Analysis-with-Small-Samples.pdf)
- Licence: CC BY 4.0
- [FlairMI page](https://flairmi.com/textbooks/smallsamplelab.html)
- Coverage: 18 chapters and 5 worked R projects on exact tests, resampling,
  nonparametric methods, penalised and Bayesian regression, missing data,
  uncertainty reporting, and small-sample study design.

**Decision Making for Management: A Student Textbook for Data-Informed
Managerial Judgement** (live, rolling release)

- A Villa College course textbook teaching descriptive and inferential
  statistics through management decisions, with every analysis run in JASP or
  PocketStat. The first 2 chapters are live.
- [Web edition](https://mohammedalisharafuddin.github.io/dmm-textbook/)

**The Evidence-Based Digital Marketer** (live, rolling release)

- A 15-week open digital marketing course textbook (MKTG3001): campaign
  strategy, open marketing analytics and responsible AI. 6 of its 15 weeks
  are live, free under CC BY 4.0.
- [Web edition](https://mohammedalisharafuddin.github.io/digital-marketing-2026/)
- [FlairMI page](https://flairmi.com/textbooks/dmarketing.html)

## Open-source software

**surveyframe** (v0.4.2, live on CRAN since 25 September 2026) is an R
package for survey instrument objects and end-to-end survey workflows:
instrument design, static HTML export, a Shiny module, response quality
checks, scale scoring, psychometric diagnostics, analysis planning, and
reproducible HTML reporting. The instrument's analysis plan is declared
before data collection and executed as declared. Version 0.4.0 added
multi-criteria decision analysis (10 methods), text analysis of open-ended
responses (9 methods), small-sample corrections and a disclosed-amendment
and Git-linked provenance trail. Version 0.4.1 added a 22-demo teaching
library and labelled SPSS and Stata export. MIT licence, free.

- Install: `install.packages("surveyframe")`
- [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=surveyframe)
- [Documentation](https://mohammedalisharafuddin.github.io/surveyframe/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/MohammedAliSharafuddin/surveyframe)
- A manuscript describing the package is in preparation for the R Journal,
  pinned to CRAN 0.4.0. It was rejected on scope by the Journal of
  Statistical Software on 7 August 2026 and retargeted.
- Companion methodology preprint: [Social Science Research 6.0: A
  Proof-of-Integrity Framework for Tamper-Evident Survey
  Instruments](https://doi.org/10.31235/osf.io/jmbv8_v1)

## Blog

FlairMI publishes applied statistics tutorials and product notes at
[flairmi.com/blog](https://flairmi.com/blog/). Recent posts:

- ["surveyframe 0.4.1 is on CRAN"](https://flairmi.com/blog/posts/13-surveyframe-0-4-1-cran.html)
  is the 0.4.1 release notes: a 22-demo teaching library, labelled SPSS and
  Stata export, seeded reproducible reports and 2 fixes for defects that
  could silently corrupt collected data.
- ["surveyframe 0.4.0 is on CRAN"](https://flairmi.com/blog/posts/12-surveyframe-0-4-0-cran.html)
  is the 0.4.0 release notes: 10 multi-criteria decision analysis methods,
  9 text-analysis methods for open-ended responses, small-sample corrections,
  and a disclosed-amendment and Git-linked provenance trail.
- ["surveyframe 0.3.3 is on CRAN"](https://flairmi.com/blog/posts/07-surveyframe-0-3-3-cran.html)
  — the 0.3.3 release notes: redesigned exported survey, WCAG 2.2 AA
  accessibility, an opt-in ggplot2 plotting layer and a diverging bar
  chart for Likert results.
- ["Why the analysis plan comes first"](https://flairmi.com/blog/posts/08-analysis-plan-before-data.html)
  — why surveyframe requires the analysis plan to be declared before data
  collection, and why that matters beyond academic research.
- ["surveyframe Field Types: Single Choice"](https://flairmi.com/blog/posts/09-surveyframe-single-choice.html)
  — a worked, runnable example declaring a single_choice question, its
  codebook, its exported survey, and its analysis output.
- ["Persona Builder: a free browser tool for personas"](https://flairmi.com/blog/posts/10-persona-builder.html)
  — building a UX or marketing persona card at one of three detail levels,
  then exporting it as a PNG or PDF.
- ["surveyframe Field Types: Multiple Choice"](https://flairmi.com/blog/posts/11-surveyframe-multiple-choice.html)
  — a worked, runnable example declaring a multiple_choice question,
  including why `frequency` is the wrong analysis method for it and
  `cochran_q` is the right one.

## Free browser tools

- **[Price Memory](https://flairmi.com/products/price-memory.html)** (live,
  free) — a personal grocery price tracker that stores history locally in
  the browser.
- **[Margin Guard](https://flairmi.com/products/margin-guard.html)** (live,
  free) — a promotion break-even calculator for pricing and campaign
  decisions.
- **[Persona Builder](https://flairmi.com/tools/persona-builder/)**
  (live, free) — a UX research and marketing persona card builder with
  four detail levels (the fourth records the persona stage by stage for
  customer journey mapping) and PNG, PDF and JSON export, data stays in
  the browser's local storage.
## Marketing Toolkit Hub

[flairmi.com/toolkit/](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/) holds 32 free marketing tools in five categories. Every tool runs in the browser with no account, keeps data on the user's device and shows its formula or method on the page in plain HTML. Each page carries WebApplication and FAQPage structured data. Tools marked live are ready for use. The others are marked in progress while they are tested with real use.

### [Strategic Analysis](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/strategic-analysis.html)

- **[SWOT Analysis Builder](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/swot-analysis.html)** (in progress): Strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats, each item scored by impact and likelihood and ranked on a scatter plot.
- **[PESTEL Analysis Builder](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/pestel-analysis.html)** (in progress): Political, economic, social, technological, environmental and legal factors, each scored and ranked on a scatter plot.
- **[Porter's Five Forces Analyser](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/porters-five-forces.html)** (in progress): Score the five competitive forces, see them on a radar chart and rate the industry's attractiveness.
- **[Ansoff Matrix Tool](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/ansoff-matrix.html)** (in progress): Plot growth initiatives by product and market newness, sized by investment, with a risk score for each.

### [Customer Understanding](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/customer-understanding.html)

- **[Persona Builder](https://flairmi.com/tools/persona-builder/)** (live): Persona cards at four detail levels, including a stage-by-stage Journey level, exported as PNG, PDF or JSON.
- **[STP Builder](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/stp-builder.html)** (in progress): Segmentation, targeting and positioning as an interactive dot-cluster diagram, ending in a draft campaign brief.
- **[Customer Journey Mapper](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/customer-journey-mapper.html)** (live): Each persona's goal, emotion and segment stage by stage, with a service blueprint and pain points tagged to the four service gaps.
- **[Importance-Performance Analysis Matrix](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/ipa-matrix.html)** (in progress): Attributes plotted by importance and performance, sorted into concentrate here, keep up the good work, low priority and possible overkill.
- **[RFM Segmentation Tool](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/rfm-segmentation.html)** (in progress): Paste transactions, score customers on recency, frequency and monetary value and get segments with an action for each.
- **[Value Proposition Canvas](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/value-proposition-canvas.html)** (in progress): An interactive canvas: drag notes onto the value map and customer profile, match them and see how well they fit.

### [Portfolio and Growth](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/portfolio-and-growth.html)

- **[BCG Growth-Share Matrix](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/bcg-matrix.html)** (in progress): Products by market growth and relative share, sized by revenue, classed as stars, cash cows, question marks or dogs.
- **[GE-McKinsey Matrix](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/ge-mckinsey-matrix.html)** (in progress): Weighted industry attractiveness and competitive strength factors, scored per business unit on a nine-box grid.
- **[Product Life Cycle Stage Identifier](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/product-life-cycle.html)** (in progress): Fit an S-curve to sales history, estimate the current life cycle stage and see mix priorities for it.
- **[Diffusion of Innovation Adopter Calculator](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/diffusion-of-innovation.html)** (in progress): Place adoption on Rogers' curve, see which adopter group you are reaching, and fit the Bass model for a forecast.

### [Planning and Execution](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/planning-and-execution.html)

- **[7Ps Marketing Mix Planner](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/7ps-marketing-mix-planner.html)** (in progress): Plan all seven Ps against one segment and positioning statement, and rate how well each P supports it.
- **[Campaign Brief Generator](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/campaign-brief-generator.html)** (in progress): Pull persona, positioning and mix plan into one brief with objective, KPIs, budget split and timeline.
- **[UTM Campaign URL Builder](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/utm-builder.html)** (in progress): Tag campaign links with consistent UTM parameters, singly or in bulk, with warnings for common naming mistakes.
- **[Meta Tag and Open Graph Preview](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/meta-tag-preview.html)** (in progress): Preview a page in search and social cards, check title and description length and copy the tags.
- **[Schema Markup Generator](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/schema-markup-generator.html)** (in progress): Write JSON-LD structured data for eight common schema types, with required fields flagged.
- **[Canonical Tag Generator](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/canonical-tag-generator.html)** (in progress): Normalise URL variants, strip tracking parameters and see which duplicates collapse into one canonical tag.
- **[Readability and Headline Analyser](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/readability-analyser.html)** (in progress): Flesch scores, sentence-length chart, long sentences marked and a headline check for length and keyword position.
- **[Robots.txt and Sitemap Generator](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/robots-sitemap-generator.html)** (in progress): Write robots.txt rules, including choices for AI crawlers, and a valid sitemap.xml from a URL list.
- **[Colour Contrast Checker](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/colour-contrast-checker.html)** (in progress): WCAG contrast ratios with AA and AAA results, a suggested passing colour and a whole-palette check.
- **[Hashtag and Character Counter](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/hashtag-character-counter.html)** (in progress): Count characters, hashtags, mentions and links against nine social platforms' limits, with X's link rule applied.
- **[A/B Test Sample Size and Significance Calculator](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/ab-test-calculator.html)** (in progress): Size an A/B test before it runs, then test the result with a z-test and confidence intervals.

### [Performance and Analytics](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/performance-and-analytics.html)

- **[SERVQUAL Gap Analysis](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/servqual-gap-analysis.html)** (live): Expectations against perceptions on 22 items across five dimensions, weighted, with the largest gaps ranked.
- **[Brand Equity Assessor](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/brand-equity-assessor.html)** (in progress): Keller's six brand building blocks scored and drawn as the brand resonance pyramid, with the weakest block flagged.
- **[Customer Lifetime Value Calculator](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/clv-calculator.html)** (in progress): Discounted customer lifetime value with retention, the CLV to CAC ratio and months to recover acquisition cost.
- **[Price Elasticity Calculator](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/price-elasticity-calculator.html)** (in progress): Arc and point elasticity from two price points, elastic or inelastic, with revenue and profit curves.
- **[Net Promoter Score Tracker](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/nps-tracker.html)** (in progress): Calculate NPS with its margin of error and track it across survey waves, with a test of whether a change is real.
- **[Marketing Attribution Comparison](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/attribution-comparison.html)** (in progress): Apply five attribution models to the same conversion paths and see how each channel's credit changes.
- **[MMM Analyser](https://flairmi.com/toolkit/mmm-analyser.html)** (in progress): A small marketing mix model with carryover and diminishing returns, showing contribution, ROI and response curves per channel.

The classroom case in the Customer Journey Mapper, and its feeling words, are adapted from O'Rourke et al. (2026), Consumer Behavior in Tourism and Hospitality, 21(3), 382-401, CC BY 4.0.

## Free Excel templates

Ten Excel workbooks for marketing analytics: Campaign ROI Tracker, Sales
Pipeline Tracker, Revenue Forecast Model, Marketing Funnel Dashboard, RFM
Segmentation, CLV Calculator, CAC Calculator, Churn Rate Dashboard,
Break-Even Analysis, Competitive Positioning Map.

- [Full collection](https://flairmi.com/templates/)

## Consulting and workshops

FlairMI offers consulting and workshops in business analytics, marketing
analytics, small-sample methods and reproducible workflows, by enquiry.
No published pricing or checkout exists yet.
